description: Surface the judgment history that already exists on disk but is invisible. Revisions (`rev`), the `supersedes: <slug>#r<N>` chain, and retraction tombstones are all persisted, but the only read surface — get_judgment_state (judgment-writer.js:3354) — returns the LATEST revision per position and nothing else. Slice A: a trace op that walks a position back through its revisions and supersession chain, exposing what it replaced and why. Purely additive, no schema change, no external dependency. Slice B (semantic precedent search) remains BLOCKED on the unresolved SmartMemory recall failure. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-JUDGMENT-PRECEDENT/plan.md
source: Semantica teardown 2026-08-08; re-grounded against code 2026-08-08 after design gate

completions.notes: Slice A shipped; 503 tests green; 4 Codex review rounds. Slice B remains BLOCKED (SmartMemory recall).
